name: The Nilgiris
soil: PEATY LOAM · SILTY CLAY SHOLA MOSAIC

narrative.canopy: 2,600m elevation. High altitude, low temperature, severe mist.
narrative.land: Peaty loam and silty clay. Heavy moisture retention, cold soil.
narrative.hand: Harvested continuously throughout the year depending on the flush. Physical labor at high altitude requires significant stamina.
